Name: }bedrock.process.execute_externally

Parameters.Name: pProcess
Parameters.Prompt: REQUIRED: Name of the process to run on the target database

Parameters.Name: pProcessParameters
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object of parameter values for the process, e.g. {"pCube": "Sales"}

Parameters.Name: pSourceConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Connection to copy the process from if it does not exist on the target: a connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it (blank = this database)

Parameters.Name: pTargetConnectionName
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Connection of the database to run the process on: a connection name in }bedrock.session.start, or a connection-details JSON object returned by it (blank = this database)

Parameters.Name: pLogOutput
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: Write parameters and action summary to server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pStrictErrorHandling
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: On encountering any error, exit with major error status by ProcessQuit after writing to the server message log (Boolean. Default = 0)

Parameters.Name: pJson
Parameters.Prompt: OPTIONAL: JSON Object with process parameter values. This will overwrite user passed parameters for all included parameters.
